parameters.name: includeNokAccounts
parameters.description: Specify whether the response should contain NOK accounts

parameters.name: includeCurrencyAccounts
parameters.description: Specify whether the response should contain currency accounts

parameters.name: includeBsuAccounts
parameters.description: Specify whether the response should contain BSU accounts

parameters.name: includeCreditCardAccounts
parameters.description: Specify whether the response should contain credit card accounts. Always excluded for application users. If the credit cards cannot be fetched, they are left out of the response instead of failing the request.

parameters.name: includeAskAccounts
parameters.description: Specify whether the response should contain ASK accounts (aksjesparekonto)

parameters.name: includePensionAccounts
parameters.description: Specify whether the response should contain pension agreements

get.description: Lists deposit accounts the caller owns or has a role on, optionally together with credit cards and pension agreements. Credit cards and pension agreements are returned in the same AccountDTO format, but their key cannot be used with the other /accounts endpoints.

key.description: The key of the account. Used for further requests towards the account API. For credit cards this is the card id, and for pension agreements the policy number. These keys cannot be used with the other /accounts endpoints.

iban.description: Account IBAN. Empty string for credit card and pension accounts.

name.description: The name of the account. Uses the users preferred name if it exists, falls back to system name if not. For credit cards this is the masked card number, and for pension agreements the agreement name.

type.description:
The account type. Possible values:
        - USER: Local currency deposit user account, including flexi loan accounts (see isFlexiLoan)
        - SAVING: Local currency deposit saving account
        - BSU: Local currency deposit BSU account
        - ELS: Currency deposit loan account
        - IFRS: Local currency IFRS account
        - PENSION: Pension account
        - SAVEAGREE: Local currency savings agreement account
        - STOCKSAVING: Share savings account (aksjesparekonto)
        - TAXWITHDRAW: Local currency tax withdrawal account
        - YEARINTBONUS: Local currency deposit yearly interest bonus account
        - CREDITCARD: Credit card
        - UNKNOWN: Unknown host value

balance.description: The booked balance of the account, in the monetary unit represented by the currency code. The format is the monetary unit followed by . and two digits of cent. The value of cent in this context is one hundredth of the monetary unit. 12.67 in NOK would equal 12 kroners and 67 ore. For pension accounts this is the market value of the agreement.

items.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS NULL - List of OBS codes for the account

obsCodes.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS NULL - List of OBS codes for the account

productId.description: The product id. Not present for credit card and pension accounts.

description.description: A description of the account. For credit cards this is the card product name. Not present for pension accounts.

productType.description:
The product code for the account. Possible values:
        - LOCDEPOSIT: Local currency deposit.
        - CURDEPOSIT: Currency deposit.
        - UNKNOWN: Unknown host value, and for credit card and pension accounts.

accountNumber.description: The unformatted account number, 11 digits for deposit accounts. For credit cards this is the card account number (prefixed with K), and for pension agreements the policy number prefixed with P.

descriptionCode.description: The description code for the account type

availableBalance.description: The available balance of the account, in the monetary unit represented by the currency code. The format is the monetary unit followed by . and two digits of cent. The value of cent in this context is one hundredth of the monetary unit. 12.67 in NOK would equal 12 kroners and 67 ore. For credit cards this equals balance, and for pension accounts it is always 0.00.

creditCardAccountID.description: ID of the account (AccountId from the backend system KKINT). Present for all credit card accounts. Not present for any other accounts.

creditCardCreditLimit.description: The granted credit limit of the card. Present for all credit card accounts. Not present for any other accounts. In the monetary unit represented by the currency code. The format is the monetary unit followed by . and two digits of cent. The value of cent in this context is one hundredth of the monetary unit. 12.67 in NOK would equal 12 kroners and 67 ore

age.description: The customer's age. Only present when the owner is identified by a national identity number

name.description: The customer's full name, i.e. first name and last name separated by a space

ssnKey.description: The customer's social security number encrypted. A different value will be generated for each call. Only present when the owner is identified by a national identity number

lastName.description: The customer's last name. For corporate customers this is the company name

customerKey.description: The customer's key. Only present when the owner is identified by a national identity number

organisationNumber.description: The customer's 9 digit organisation number. Only present when the owner is identified by an organisation number

CustomerDTO.description: The owner of the account. Not present for credit card and pension accounts.

isOwned.description: The user owns the account. At most one of isOwned, userHasRightOfDisposal and userHasRightOfAccess is true

isHidden.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS FALSE - The account should be hidden in user interfaces

hasAccess.description: The user has access to the account. Always true, except for pension accounts

isBlocked.description: Access to the account has been blocked

isFlexiLoan.description: The account is a flexiloan account

isBonusAccount.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS FALSE - The account is a bonus account

isCodebitorLoan.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS FALSE - The account is a codebitor loan

isSavingsAccount.description: The account is a savings account

isAksjesparekonto.description: The account is a share savings account

isSecurityBalance.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS FALSE - The account is a security balance

isTransferToEnabled.description: Transfers to the account is enabled

isPaymentFromEnabled.description: Payments from the account is enabled

isWithdrawalsAllowed.description: Withdrawals from the account are allowed. Always true, except for pension accounts

userHasRightOfAccess.description: The user has right of access (read only) to the account, without owning it or having right of disposal. At most one of isOwned, userHasRightOfDisposal and userHasRightOfAccess is true

isAllowedInAvtaleGiro.description: Is allowed as debit account in AvtaleGiro agreements

isTransferFromEnabled.description: Transfers from the account is enabled

userHasRightOfDisposal.description: The user has right of disposal for the account, without owning it. At most one of isOwned, userHasRightOfDisposal and userHasRightOfAccess is true

isDefaultPaymentAccount.description: The account is the users preferred default payment account

isBalanceUpdatedImmediatelyOnTransferTo.description: If true, the account balance is updated immediately when transferring money to the account. If false, the balance will normally be updated within a few hours or days depending on the account type
